name: light_sleeper
caption: why is my whole village carpeted 😶
logline: A boy in a village where every inch is carpeted and the bell is wrapped in wool wants to hear one song, and puts a jukebox on the well.
question: why tf is the whole village covered in carpet?
premise: Every road, roof and stair in the boy's village is carpeted, 300 sheep are sheared every morning, and the bell is boxed in wool so nobody has ever heard it. Mom says 'walk soft, the ground's a light sleeper'. Once he threw an egg down the well and the glowing moss at the bottom screamed; Mom said it was a fox. Then a skeleton shoots a creeper and he gets a music disc.
twist: The carpet is silence. The village sits on an ancient city and the 'glowing moss' at the bottom of the well is a sculk shrieker. He puts a jukebox on the well and dances: four shrieks, the Darkness pulsing ('like a real party'), and the warden rises out of the square. He was obliterated by a sonically-charged shriek.

N.name: me
N.profile: a boy of about ten telling the whole story in a whisper, because in his village everyone whispers; clear, curious, close to the mic; brightens and speeds up when he's excited
N.on_screen: pov (hand visible, never his face); seen only as a small figure from behind in S12 and S16

Mom.name: Mom
Mom.profile: his mother; warm, half-whispered, says everything like a lullaby to a sleeping baby; careful under the warmth; never raises her voice, even when she's terrified
Mom.on_screen: villager, plains farmer (straw hat), no name tag

requests.direction: A village where everyone whispers. A boy tells a friend a secret story in a hushed voice; his mother speaks softly, like a lullaby. Nobody ever shouts.

lines.text: My village / is covered in / NINE THOUSAND / CARPETS.
lines.say: My village is covered in... nine thousand carpets.
lines.direction: a whisper close to the mic, as if the floor could hear; a held breath before the number

lines.text: The ROADS. / The ROOFS. / Even the DOGHOUSE.
lines.direction: a whispered list, each item a little more amazed, a small smile on the last

lines.text: We keep / THREE HUNDRED / sheep. / We shear them / every MORNING.
lines.direction: hushed and matter-of-fact, this is normal to him

lines.text: Our BELL / is wrapped / in WOOL. / I've never / HEARD it.
lines.direction: hushed wonder; a small pause before the last phrase

lines.text: Walk SOFT, / sweetie. / The ground's / a light SLEEPER.
lines.say: Walk soft, sweetie. <short pause> The ground's a light sleeper.
lines.direction: lullaby-warm and half-whispered, smiling; something careful under it; the last word held a moment

lines.text: Once, / I threw an EGG / down the WELL.
The bottom / of the well / SCREAMED.
lines.say: The bottom of the well... screamed.
lines.direction: the whisper drops lower; a breath held before the last word

lines.text: Mom held me / in the DARK. / She said / it was a FOX.
Then a skeleton / shot a CREEPER / by the farm. / It dropped / a music DISC.
lines.direction: the whisper brightens and speeds up, excited, the best news of his life

lines.text: Nobody here / has ever heard / a SONG.
lines.direction: slow and longing; this is the want

lines.text: So tonight, / I put a JUKEBOX / on the WELL.
lines.say: So tonight... I put a jukebox on the well.
lines.direction: a held breath before he starts; determined, a little proud

lines.text: The fox / screamed AGAIN. / I didn't CARE.
lines.direction: giddy and defiant, still a whisper, a grin in it
a breathless whisper, terrified, still trying to sound gentle; long gaps between the words

lines.text: The music / made the lights / go DARK. / Like a real PARTY.
lines.direction: delighted and wonder-struck, not hearing her at all
almost laughing, the happiest he has ever sounded, trailing off

beats: the fourth shriek (the shrieker's sound and its soul rings), the Darkness at full pulse
the carpet in front of the well bursts: the warden rises out of the square (S16, camera)
the warden roars (roar pose, 4.2 s, cut short at ~1.5 s), turns to the POV, sonic boom (S17, POV)
death screen: 'HelloBuh was obliterated by a sonically-charged shriek', held ~1.3 s, the jukebox music still playing under it, the caption track repeating 'obliterated by a sonically-charged shriek'
cut 0.25 s after the hold; no spoken line after the reveal (owner, 2026-11-07)
ending.loop: cause and effect: the shriek is why L01's village is covered in nine thousand carpets

shots.camera: pov, slow push forward and a slight tilt down
shots.frame: fg: the carpeted roof edge of our house and a sheared sheep on it; mid: the plaza, the wool-boxed bell on its post, the well; bg: carpet-striped roofs stepping down the valley, the sheep meadow on the far slope, forest and hills into the fog. Dusk.

shots.camera: pov walking slowly down the street
shots.frame: fg: carpeted stairs up to a door; mid: a villager walking away down a road of carpet stripes; bg: the doghouse with a carpet roof and a sitting wolf (red collar), houses and the bell post beyond

shots.camera: at: high on the meadow fence, slow pan-free push in
shots.frame: fg: the meadow fence and a stack of wool blocks; mid: the meadow, ~120 sheep in view, half of them sheared bald; bg: the village roofs and the forest. Morning.

shots.camera: pov, slow push in to the bell
shots.frame: fg: plaza carpet; subject: the bell on its post inside a box of white wool, front side open so the gold shows; bg: house fronts around the plaza, lanterns

shots.camera: pov at a child's height, looking slightly up
shots.frame: fg: the carpeted doorstep; subject: Mom, head to foot in the open doorway, looking down at the camera; bg: the lit room behind her, carpet on the floor, a second chair

shots.camera: pov at the well's rim, looking down into the shaft as the egg is thrown
shots.frame: fg: the stone rim of the well; subject: the egg arcing down the 3x3 shaft; bg: the shaft walls going dark, a faint teal glow at the bottom (5 blocks down). Afternoon (flashback, warm light).

shots.camera: at: inside the shaft, 1.5 blocks from the shrieker, looking down at it
shots.frame: fg: sculk veins on the shaft wall; subject: the sculk shrieker opening its mouth, the soul rings rising; bg: two sculk sensors, tendrils twitching. The shriek on 'SCREAMED', the Darkness begins.

shots.camera: pov, still, the Darkness pulse fading out
shots.frame: fg: the carpet floor; subject: Mom, waist up, standing very close; bg: the lantern on the wall and the dark window

shots.camera: pov from the end of the carpet, looking out over the field to the forest edge
shots.frame: fg: the last row of carpet where the village ends and grass begins; mid: wheat field; bg: at the forest edge a skeleton (left) shoots a creeper (right); it dies and a music disc pops out. Dusk.

shots.camera: pov, the disc held in the hand, turning from the doorway toward the plaza
shots.frame: fg: the hand holding the music disc; mid: the doorway; bg: the plaza at night, the well in the middle, lanterns

shots.camera: pov at the well, placing the jukebox on its rim
shots.frame: fg: the jukebox appearing on the stone rim; mid: the well; bg: the ring of house fronts, every door closed, lanterns. Night.

shots.camera: at: high crane over the plaza, slow descent
shots.frame: the whole plaza from above: the well and jukebox in the centre, a small figure (the boy, back to us) beside it, every door opening, villagers in the doorways; the Darkness pulses on 'screamed'

shots.camera: at: on the boy's eyeline from the well, 3.5 blocks in front of Mom at FOV 50, still
shots.frame: fg: the jukebox's top edge; subject: Mom, waist up, frozen in our doorway; bg: the dark house. The disc goes in at the end of the line: shriek 2.

shots.camera: pov, a slow turn from the jukebox across the doorways
shots.frame: fg: the jukebox with music-note particles; mid: the plaza carpet; bg: villagers motionless in every doorway; the light pulsing dark with the Darkness (shriek 3 on 'DARK')

shots.camera: pov, small jumps in place facing the well
shots.frame: fg: the jukebox; subject: the carpet between the well and us cracking and bursting upward, the warden's head and tendrils rising through it; bg: the far doorways. Shriek 4 on 'DANCED'.

shots.camera: at: low behind-left of the boy, 12 blocks back, looking up
shots.frame: fg: the boy, small, back to camera; subject: the warden, fully risen between him and the well, roaring; bg: the doorways and the bell box, the Darkness pulsing

shots.camera: pov, the warden filling the upper half, the sonic boom, then the death screen with the plaza still pulsing behind
shots.frame: the warden's chest and head; the sonic boom ring; 'HelloBuh was obliterated by a sonically-charged shriek'
